notes.title: Looking Ahead: New Project in the Works
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]Just a quick update and a few things I’d like to share with you.[/p][p]First of all, I understand that some of you were disappointed that [i]Narrow Escape[/i] has not been continued. As most of our games are developed by a solo developer — with occasional support from one or two interns for a limited time — and since game development is not my full-time profession, it's crucial for me to carefully choose where I invest my limited time and resources.[/p][p][i]Narrow Escape[/i] has been put on hold because it has not generated any revenue for quite some time. [i]Maze Nuts[/i] is also paused for now, as it unfortunately didn't gain much interest.[/p][p]That being said, neither project has been cancelled entirely. If there’s enough renewed interest in the future, I’d be happy to return to them.[/p][p]In the meantime, I’m currently working on a new horror-adventure project. A store page will be launched soon, and I’ll begin sharing updates and progress there.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and continued support.[/p][p]— [i]White Keyframe[/i][/p]
